exposure.needed: whether stored v1beta2 HelmRepository objects (or status updates written to them) carry status.artifact without status.artifact.digest; status is controller-written runtime state, not part of applied manifests

consequence.statement: v1beta2 HelmRepository objects whose status.artifact omits digest fail schema validation and are rejected.
consequence.remediation: Verify that HelmRepository status artifacts include a digest (the controller writes this field). Do not write status.artifact without a digest.

assertion.statement: In the source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1beta2 HelmRepository CRD schema, status.artifact.digest is now a required field, so HelmRepository objects whose status.artifact omits a digest are rejected by schema validation.
